name: The Church For the Fellowship of All People
note: sf/churches-2.ts, primitives (not church()): Art Deco/Moderne, cream stucco, 1920s-30s. Very slender square tower at the front-left corner rising well clear of the nave, an octagonal belfry stage only at the top with paired louvred slots, a rounded dome cap; three angular Deco pointed portals and a tall tracery window on the front; a dark hipped roof behind the parapet. Redone 2026-09-23 per docs/FELLOWSHIP-CHURCH.md.
